blockers.description: Google AI Studio Free Tier (15 RPM) rate limit causes upstream queuing under continuous burst load. Full 100% burst certification requires upgrading to Pay-As-You-Go tier with billing attached.
blockers.workaround: Bounded fallback to groq:allam-2-7b and pacing requests across 10-15s intervals between bursts.

decisions.decision: Set Gemini first-token deadline to 4000ms while keeping Groq deadline at 2500ms.
decisions.rationale: Empirical data showed 100% of previous Gemini failures were caused by the 2500ms deadline cutting off healthy streams delayed by Google cold starts.

decisions.decision: Use InMemoryWorkflowRepository and InMemoryToolCallRepository when DATABASE_URL is not configured.
decisions.rationale: Prevents ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:5432 crashes when tool or workflow intents are evaluated on serverless preview runtimes.

decisions.decision: Pin gemini-3.5-flash-lite as secondary Fast model over gemini-3.5-flash.
decisions.rationale: gemini-3.5-flash produces mandatory thinking tokens adding ~1940ms delay; gemini-3.5-flash-lite yields 440-650ms direct streaming TTFT with 9.8/10 technical quality.
